title.zh: 卷435 列傳二百二十二 华尔 勒伯勒东 法尔第福 戈登 日意格 德克碑 赫德 帛黎
title.en: Volume 435 Biographies 222: Hua Er, Lei Bo Lei Dong, Fa Er Di Fu, Ge Deng, Ri Yi Ge, De Ke Bei, He De, Bo Li
title.raw: 卷435 列傳二百二十二 华尔 勒伯勒东 法尔第福 戈登 日意格 德克碑 赫德 帛黎

sentences.zh: 列傳二百二十二

translations.literal: Biographies 222
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 222

sentences.zh: 華爾勒伯勒東法爾第福戈登日意格德克碑赫德帛黎

translations.literal: Ward, Lebreton, Fard-Fourcand, Gordon, Degeorge, D'Aiguibelle, Hart, Protet
translations.idiomatic: Ward, Lebreton, Fard-Fourcand, Gordon, Degeorge, D'Aiguibelle, Hart, and Protet

sentences.zh: 華爾，美國紐約人。

translations.literal: Ward was a man of New York in the United States.
translations.idiomatic: Ward was a native of New York in the United States.

sentences.zh: 嘗為其國將弁，以罪廢來上海，國人欲執之。

translations.literal: He had once been an officer of his country; dismissed for a crime he came to Shanghai, and his countrymen wished to seize him.
translations.idiomatic: He had once served as an officer in his own country, but was cashiered for misconduct and came to Shanghai, where his compatriots sought to arrest him.

sentences.zh: 會粵匪陷蘇州，上海籌防，謀練精兵。

translations.literal: Just then the Cantonese rebels took Suzhou; Shanghai prepared defenses and planned to train elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Taiping rebels had taken Suzhou, and Shanghai was organizing its defenses and planning to drill elite troops.

sentences.zh: 蘇松太道吳煦識其才，言於美領事，獲免，以是德之，原效力，俾領印度兵。

translations.literal: The Su-Song-Tai Circuit Intendant Wu Xu recognized his talent, spoke to the American consul, and secured his exemption; in gratitude he offered his service and was put in command of Indian troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Su-Song-Tai Circuit Intendant Wu Xu recognized his ability, appealed to the American consul, and secured his release; grateful for this, Ward offered his services and was placed in command of Indian troops.

sentences.zh: 既撤，自陳原隸中國。

translations.literal: When those troops were withdrawn, he declared that he wished to serve under China.
translations.idiomatic: After those troops were withdrawn, he stated that he wished to enter Chinese service.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，粵匪陷松江，煦令募西兵數十為前驅；

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng the Cantonese rebels took Songjiang; Xu ordered the recruitment of several dozen Western soldiers as vanguard;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng (1860), the rebels took Songjiang; Xu ordered several dozen Western soldiers recruited as a vanguard;

sentences.zh: 華人數百，半西服、半常裝，從其後。

translations.literal: Several hundred Chinese followed behind, half in Western dress and half in ordinary clothes.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred Chinese followed behind, half in Western uniform and half in ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 華爾誡曰：「有進無止，止者斬！

translations.literal: Ward warned them, saying: "Advance without stopping—whoever stops will be beheaded!
translations.idiomatic: Ward warned them: "Advance without halt; whoever halts will be beheaded!

sentences.zh: 」賊迎戰，槍砲雨下，令伏，無一傷者。

translations.literal: " The rebels met them in battle; guns and cannon rained down; he ordered them to lie flat, and not one was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: " The rebels met them in battle with a rain of musket and cannon fire; he ordered his men to lie flat, and not one was wounded.

sentences.zh: 俄突起轟擊之，百二十槍齊發，凡三發，斃賊數百。

translations.literal: Suddenly he rose and bombarded them; one hundred and twenty guns fired together, three volleys in all, and several hundred rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly he sprang up and opened fire; one hundred and twenty rifles discharged together in three volleys, killing several hundred rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊敗入城，躡之同入，巷戰，斬黃衣賊數人。

translations.literal: The rebels were defeated and fled into the city; he pursued them inside, fought in the lanes, and beheaded several rebels in yellow coats.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were beaten and fled into the city; he pursued them inside, fought through the streets, and beheaded several rebels in yellow coats.

sentences.zh: 賊遁走，遂復松江，華爾亦被創。

translations.literal: The rebels fled; Songjiang was recovered, and Ward was also wounded.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled, and Songjiang was recovered; Ward was wounded as well.

sentences.zh: 先是煦與華爾約，城克，罄賊所有以予。

translations.literal: Earlier Xu and Ward had agreed that if the city were taken, all the rebels' possessions would be given to him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xu and Ward had agreed that if the city fell, Ward would receive everything the rebels possessed.

sentences.zh: 至是入賊館，空無所得，以五千金酬之。

translations.literal: When they entered the rebels' quarters they found nothing; five thousand taels of silver were paid him as reward.
translations.idiomatic: When they entered the rebel quarters they found nothing; he was paid five thousand taels of silver as compensation.

sentences.zh: 令守松江，又募練洋槍隊五百，服裝器械步伐皆效西人。

translations.literal: He was ordered to hold Songjiang and recruited five hundred men for a drilled musket corps, whose dress, arms, and drill all imitated Westerners.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to defend Songjiang and recruited five hundred men into a drilled musket corps, with uniform, weapons, and drill all modeled on Western practice.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，賊又犯松江富林、塘橋，眾數万，直偪城下。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi the rebels again attacked Fulin and Tangqiao near Songjiang with tens of thousands of men, pressing straight to the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) the rebels again attacked Fulin and Tangqiao near Songjiang with a force of tens of thousands, pressing directly against the walls.

sentences.zh: 華爾以五百人御之，被圍，乃分其眾為數圓陣，陣五重，人四鄉，最內者平立，以次遞俯，槍皆外指。

translations.literal: Ward with five hundred men resisted them; surrounded, he divided his force into several circular formations, five ranks deep, four men facing each direction; those innermost stood upright, each rank successively lower, all guns pointing outward.
translations.idiomatic: Ward met them with five hundred men; surrounded, he divided his force into several circular formations five ranks deep, four men facing each compass point; the innermost rank stood upright, each outer rank kneeling lower in turn, all rifles pointing outward.

sentences.zh: 華爾居中吹角，一響眾應，三發，死賊數百。

translations.literal: Ward stood at the center and blew a horn; at one blast all responded; three volleys were fired and several hundred rebels died.
translations.idiomatic: Ward stood at the center and blew a horn; at one blast all answered; three volleys killed several hundred rebels.

sentences.zh: 逐北辰山，再被創，力疾與戰，賊始退。

translations.literal: He pursued them to Beichen Hill, was wounded again, fought on through illness, and the rebels at last withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued them to Beichen Hill, was wounded again, and fought on despite his wounds until the rebels finally withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遂會諸軍搗敵營，殺守門者，爭先入毀之。

translations.literal: He then joined the other armies in storming the enemy camp, killed the gate guards, and all vied to enter first and destroy it.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the other armies in storming the enemy camp, killed the gate guards, and all strove to be first inside and destroy it.

sentences.zh: 是役也，以寡敵眾，稱奇捷。

translations.literal: In this battle, with few against many, the victory was acclaimed as extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: In this engagement, few against many, the victory was hailed as remarkable.

sentences.zh: 時浦東賊據高橋，偪上海，華爾約英、法兵守海濱，而自率所部進擊，賊大敗，加四品翎頂。

translations.literal: At that time rebels in eastern Pudong held Gaoqiao and threatened Shanghai; Ward arranged for British and French troops to guard the coast while he led his own force forward in attack; the rebels were heavily defeated, and he was given fourth-rank insignia and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rebels in eastern Pudong held Gaoqiao and threatened Shanghai; Ward arranged for British and French troops to guard the coast while he led his own force in attack; the rebels were routed, and he was granted fourth-rank insignia and the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 會李鴻章帥師至滬，乃隸戲下，令立常勝軍，益募兵三千俾教練，參將李恆嵩副之，餉倍發。

translations.literal: When Li Hongzhang arrived at Shanghai in command of the army, Ward was placed under him; he was ordered to form the Ever-Victorious Army, and three thousand more troops were recruited for him to train, with Assistant General Li Hengsong as his deputy, at double pay.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Hongzhang arrived at Shanghai in command of the army, Ward was placed under him and ordered to form the Ever-Victorious Army; three thousand more men were recruited for him to train, with Assistant General Li Hengsong as deputy, at double pay.

sentences.zh: 賊據王家寺，與英提督何伯等合攻。

translations.literal: The rebels held Wangjia Temple; he joined British Admiral Hope and others in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Wangjia Temple; he joined British Admiral Hope and others in attacking it.

sentences.zh: 華爾賈勇先入，大斬虜首，進偪南翔，賊亦悉眾轟拒，何伯負傷。

translations.literal: Ward with desperate courage entered first and took many heads; pressing on toward Nanxiang, the rebels mustered all their strength and met him with heavy fire; Hope was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Ward charged in first with desperate courage and took many heads; pressing toward Nanxiang, the rebels mustered their full strength and met him with heavy fire; Hope was wounded.

sentences.zh: 華爾冒煙直進，立毀其營，生獲八百餘人，遂復嘉定。

translations.literal: Ward advanced straight through the smoke, immediately destroyed their camp, and captured more than eight hundred alive; Jiading was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Ward pushed straight through the smoke, immediately destroyed their camp, and took more than eight hundred prisoners alive; Jiading was recovered.

sentences.zh: 規取青浦，華爾略東門，城潰；

translations.literal: Planning to take Qingpu, Ward attacked the east gate and the wall collapsed;
translations.idiomatic: Planning to take Qingpu, Ward attacked the east gate and the wall collapsed;

sentences.zh: 英、法兵自西入，華爾為承。

translations.literal: British and French troops entered from the west; Ward served as the supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: British and French troops entered from the west while Ward served as the supporting force.

sentences.zh: 賊奔，爭赴水死。

translations.literal: The rebels fled and all rushed into the water to die.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled, many throwing themselves into the water to drown.

sentences.zh: 攻奉賢，法提督卜羅德遇害，詔賞貂皮採絨，卹其家。

translations.literal: Attacking Fengxian, the French Admiral Prol d'Vesques was killed; an edict granted sable fur and velvet in reward and provided relief to his family.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Fengxian, French Admiral Prol d'Vesques was killed; an edict granted sable fur and velvet as reward and provided relief to his family.

sentences.zh: 時恆嵩扼趙屯港、四江口，屢失利，嘉、青复危。

translations.literal: At that time Li Hengsong held Zhao Tun Harbor and Sijiangkou but suffered repeated defeats; Jiading and Qingpu were again in danger.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Li Hengsong held Zhao Tun Harbor and Sijiangkou but suffered repeated defeats, and Jiading and Qingpu were again imperiled.

sentences.zh: 華爾方議直搗金山衛，聞敗，還守青浦。

translations.literal: Ward was planning a direct strike on Jinshanwei when he heard of the defeat and returned to defend Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: Ward was planning a direct strike on Jinshanwei when he heard of the defeat and returned to defend Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 而富林、泗涇又相繼失，乃棄青浦，簡壯士五百襲天馬山，破之。

translations.literal: Fulin and Sijing were also lost in succession; he abandoned Qingpu, selected five hundred picked men to raid Tianma Hill, and broke the enemy there.
translations.idiomatic: Fulin and Sijing were also lost in succession; he abandoned Qingpu, selected five hundred picked men to raid Tianma Hill, and broke the enemy there.

sentences.zh: 入城挈守軍出，並力守松江，登陴轟擊兩晝夜不絕，賊宵遁，圍解。

translations.literal: He entered the city and brought out the garrison, combined forces to defend Songjiang, and for two days and nights shelled from the walls without cease; the rebels fled by night and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the city and brought out the garrison, combined forces to defend Songjiang, and for two days and nights shelled from the walls without cease; the rebels fled by night and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 官軍圖青浦，華爾攻南門，駕輪舶入濠，毀城十餘丈，麾眾登堞，賊鬥且走，追敗之白鶴江黃渡，復其城，晉副將銜，降敕褒賞。

translations.literal: The government armies planned for Qingpu; Ward attacked the south gate, drove a steamer into the moat, destroyed more than ten zhang of wall, directed his men onto the battlements, the rebels fought as they fled, pursued and defeated them at Baihe River and Huangdu, recovered the city, was promoted to vice general, and received an edict of praise and reward.
translations.idiomatic: The government armies planned the recovery of Qingpu; Ward attacked the south gate, drove a steamer into the moat, destroyed more than ten zhang of wall, directed his men onto the battlements; the rebels fought as they fled; he pursued and defeated them at Baihe River and Huangdu, recovered the city, was promoted to vice general, and received an edict of praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 俄偽慕王譚紹光復來犯，薄西門，與總兵黃翼升各軍擊之，賊潰，奔北岸，華爾毀其七營。

translations.literal: Soon the false Prince of Mo Wang Tan Shaoguang came again to attack, pressing the west gate; with Brigadier Huang Yisheng and the various armies they struck him; the rebels were routed and fled to the north bank; Ward destroyed their seven camps.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the false Prince of Mo Wang Tan Shaoguang came again to attack, pressing the west gate; with Brigadier Huang Yisheng and the various armies they struck him; the rebels were routed and fled to the north bank, and Ward destroyed their seven camps.

sentences.zh: 踰月，會西兵再复嘉定。

translations.literal: After a month he joined Western troops in recovering Jiading again.
translations.idiomatic: After a month he joined Western troops in recovering Jiading again.

sentences.zh: 其秋，賊十萬复犯上海，華爾自松江倍道應赴，與諸軍擊卻之。

translations.literal: That autumn a hundred thousand rebels again attacked Shanghai; Ward came by forced march from Songjiang to answer the call and with the other armies drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn a hundred thousand rebels again attacked Shanghai; Ward came by forced march from Songjiang to answer the call and, with the other armies, drove them back.

sentences.zh: 時寧波戒嚴，巡道史致諤乞援，鴻章遣華爾偕往。

translations.literal: At that time Ningbo was on alert; Circuit Intendant Shi Zhiyi begged for aid, and Hongzhang sent Ward to accompany the relief force.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ningbo was on alert; Circuit Intendant Shi Zhiyi begged for aid, and Hongzhang sent Ward with the relief force.

sentences.zh: 值廣艇與法兵構釁，引賊寇新城，從姚北紆道犯慈谿。

translations.literal: Just then Cantonese boats clashed with French troops, drawing rebels to raid Xincheng; they took a roundabout route north of Yao to attack Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Cantonese boats clashed with French troops, drawing rebels to raid Xincheng; they took a roundabout route north of Yao to attack Cixi.

sentences.zh: 華爾約西兵駕輪舶三，一泊灌浦，一泊赭山，一自丈亭駛入太平橋、餘姚四門鎮，而自率軍數百至半浦。

translations.literal: Ward arranged for three Western steamers—one moored at Guanpu, one at Zhushan, one entering from Zhangting through Taiping Bridge and Yuyao's Simen Town—while he himself led several hundred men to Banpu.
translations.idiomatic: Ward arranged for three Western steamers—one moored at Guanpu, one at Zhushan, one entering from Zhangting through Taiping Bridge and Yuyao's Simen Town—while he himself led several hundred men to Banpu.

sentences.zh: 平旦薄城，方以遠鏡了敵，忽槍丸洞胸，遽踣地，舁回舟。

translations.literal: At dawn they pressed the city; just as he was surveying the enemy through a telescope, a bullet pierced his chest and he fell suddenly; he was carried back to the boat.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn they pressed the city; just as he was surveying the enemy through a telescope, a bullet pierced his chest and he fell suddenly; he was carried back to the boat.

sentences.zh: 餘眾悉力奮攻，賊啟北門走。

translations.literal: The rest of the force attacked with all their strength; the rebels opened the north gate and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The rest of the force attacked with all their strength; the rebels opened the north gate and fled.

sentences.zh: 華爾至郡城，猶能叱其下卹軍事，越二日始卒。

translations.literal: Ward reached the prefectural city and could still command his subordinates regarding military affairs; only after two days did he die.
translations.idiomatic: Ward reached the prefectural city and could still command his subordinates regarding military affairs; only after two days did he die.

sentences.zh: 以中國章服斂，從其志也。

translations.literal: He was buried in Chinese official dress, in accordance with his wish.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried in Chinese official dress, in accordance with his wish.

sentences.zh: 鴻章請於朝，優恤之，予寧波、松江建祠。

translations.literal: Hongzhang memorialized the court for generous relief and requested temples built at Ningbo and Songjiang in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang memorialized the court for generous relief and requested temples built at Ningbo and Songjiang in his honor.

sentences.zh: 初，喪歸，煦檢其篋，得金陵城圖，賊所居處及城垣丈尺方位纖悉畢具，論者頗稱其機密雲。

translations.literal: When the coffin first returned, Xu searched his trunk and found a map of Jinling city, with the rebels' dwellings and the city's walls and dimensions all minutely marked; commentators praised its strategic value.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin first returned, Xu searched his trunk and found a map of Jinling city, with the rebels' dwellings and the city's walls and dimensions all minutely marked; commentators praised its strategic value.

sentences.zh: 勒伯勒東德加理尼阿爾伯依都額爾，法國加爾襪多人。

translations.literal: Lebreton—full name De Graindorge Albert Edouard—was a man of Carentan in France.
translations.idiomatic: Lebreton—full name De Graindorge Albert Edouard—was from Carentan in France.

sentences.zh: 初為本國水師參將。

translations.literal: He had first been a naval adjutant of his country.
translations.idiomatic: He had first served as a naval adjutant in his own country.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十一年，來上海。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng he came to Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng (1861) he came to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 時寇據寧波，西人惡之，益兵戍守，遣勒伯勒東乘輪泊三江口。

translations.literal: At that time rebels held Ningbo; Westerners detested them and increased garrison troops; Lebreton was sent by steamer to moor at Sanjiangkou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rebels held Ningbo; Westerners detested them and increased garrison troops; Lebreton was sent by steamer to moor at Sanjiangkou.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從官軍克府城，募壯丁千五百為洋槍隊，自陳願隸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed the government army in recovering the prefectural city, recruited fifteen hundred stout men as a foreign musket corps, and declared his wish to enter Chinese service.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he followed the government army in recovering the prefectural city, recruited fifteen hundred stout men as a foreign musket corps, and declared his wish to enter Chinese service.

sentences.zh: 明年，權授浙江總兵，受巡撫、寧波道節度。

translations.literal: The next year he was provisionally appointed Zhejiang brigadier general, subject to the governor and Ningbo circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was provisionally appointed Zhejiang brigadier general, subject to the governor and Ningbo circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 時上虞賊犯泗門、馬渚，勒伯勒東軍餘姚以待。

translations.literal: At that time rebels from Shangyu attacked Simen and Mazhu; Lebreton stationed his army at Yuyao to await them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rebels from Shangyu attacked Simen and Mazhu; Lebreton stationed his army at Yuyao to await them.

sentences.zh: 尋與同知銜謝採嶂直搗賊屯，賊赴水死者千餘，乘銳毀其卡，薄城先登，擊殺守陴悍賊，餘宵遁，城克。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Expectant Sub-Prefect Xie Caizhang in a direct assault on the rebel camp; more than a thousand rebels drowned fleeing into the water; pressing their advantage they destroyed the stockade, closed on the city and scaled the wall first, killed fierce rebels defending the parapet, the rest fled by night, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he joined Expectant Sub-Prefect Xie Caizhang in a direct assault on the rebel camp; more than a thousand rebels drowned fleeing into the water; pressing their advantage they destroyed the stockade, closed on the city and scaled the wall first, killed fierce rebels defending the parapet, the rest fled by night, and the city was taken.

sentences.zh: 赴蟶浦，略紹興，以賊遺土砲往，巡道張景渠止之，不聽，未幾，砲果裂，負傷而死，賜優恤。

translations.literal: He went to Qianpu and raided toward Shaoxing, taking along a captured earth cannon the rebels had left behind; Circuit Intendant Zhang Jingqu stopped him but he would not listen; before long the cannon burst and he died of his wounds; generous relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Qianpu and raided toward Shaoxing, taking along a captured earth cannon the rebels had left behind; Circuit Intendant Zhang Jingqu stopped him but he would not listen; before long the cannon burst and he died of his wounds; generous relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 以法參將法爾第福為江蘇副將，領其軍，退守百官。

translations.literal: The French adjutant Fard-Fourcand was made Jiangsu vice general, given command of the army, and withdrew to defend Bai Guan.
translations.idiomatic: The French adjutant Fard-Fourcand was made Jiangsu vice general, given command of the army, and withdrew to defend Bai Guan.

sentences.zh: 法爾第福，又名買忒勒，頗讀華書。

translations.literal: Fard-Fourcand, also called Maitele, had read Chinese books extensively.
translations.idiomatic: Fard-Fourcand, also called Maitele, had read Chinese books extensively.

sentences.zh: 後攻紹興，焚西郭門。

translations.literal: Later he attacked Shaoxing and burned the west outer gate.
translations.idiomatic: Later he attacked Shaoxing and burned the west outer gate.

sentences.zh: 次日復戰，潰十餘丈，麾眾登城，賊殊死鬥，別有黑種人數十助之，遂遇害。

translations.literal: The next day they fought again; a breach of more than ten zhang was opened and he directed his men onto the wall; the rebels fought to the death; several dozen black men separately aided them, and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they fought again; a breach of more than ten zhang was opened and he directed his men onto the wall; the rebels fought to the death; several dozen black men separately aided them, and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 優恤之。

translations.literal: Generous relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Generous relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 戈登，英國人。

translations.literal: Gordon was an Englishman.
translations.idiomatic: Gordon was an Englishman.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，李鴻章檄領常勝軍二千攻常州、福山營。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi Li Hongzhang ordered him to lead two thousand men of the Ever-Victorious Army to attack Changzhou and the Fushan camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi (1863) Li Hongzhang ordered him to lead two thousand men of the Ever-Victorious Army to attack Changzhou and the Fushan camp.

sentences.zh: 別遣呂宋兵乘小舟薄賊壘，支木橋，伏死士城牆下。

translations.literal: Separately he sent Filipino troops in small boats to press the rebel fort, set up wooden bridges, and posted picked men beneath the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Separately he sent Filipino troops in small boats to press the rebel fort, set up wooden bridges, and posted picked men beneath the city wall.

sentences.zh: 日中，港東西賊營皆破，緣牆入，痛殲之，遂奪福山石城。

translations.literal: At midday the rebel camps east and west of the harbor were all broken; they climbed the wall and slaughtered them severely, and took the Fushan stone fort.
translations.idiomatic: At midday the rebel camps east and west of the harbor were all broken; they climbed the wall and slaughtered them severely, and took the Fushan stone fort.

sentences.zh: 圍解，權授江蘇總兵。

translations.literal: The siege was lifted; he was provisionally appointed Jiangsu brigadier general.
translations.idiomatic: The siege was lifted; he was provisionally appointed Jiangsu brigadier general.

sentences.zh: 進攻太倉，毀南門賊卡，戈登轟潰二石壘，官軍繼進，克之。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Taicang, they destroyed the south gate rebel stockade; Gordon shelled and broke two stone forts; the government army followed and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to attack Taicang, they destroyed the south gate rebel stockade; Gordon shelled and broke two stone forts; the government army followed and took the city.

sentences.zh: 規取崑山，與總兵程學啟度地勢，以環昆多水，惟西南通進義，策先斷其歸路。

translations.literal: Planning to take Kunshan, he and Brigadier General Cheng Xueqi surveyed the terrain; as Kunshan was ringed by much water, only the southwest connected to Jinyi; the plan was first to cut off their line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Planning to take Kunshan, he and Brigadier General Cheng Xueqi surveyed the terrain; as Kunshan was ringed by much water, only the southwest connected to Jinyi; the plan was first to cut off their line of retreat.

sentences.zh: 遂與駕輪舶以偏師繞而西，賊不虞其至也，即時敗奔，奪其四壘。

translations.literal: He then took a steamer with a detached force to circle west; the rebels did not expect his arrival and immediately fled in defeat; four forts were taken.
translations.idiomatic: He then took a steamer with a detached force to circle west; the rebels did not expect his arrival and immediately fled in defeat; four forts were taken.

sentences.zh: 譚紹光構悍賊來爭，與諸軍大破之，薄昆城，偕李恆嵩夾擊，賊酋偽朝將先期逸去。

translations.literal: Tan Shaoguang mustered fierce rebels to contest the ground; with the various armies he inflicted a great defeat, pressed Kunshan city, and with Li Hengsong attacked from both sides; the rebel chieftain, the false Dynasty General, escaped beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shaoguang mustered fierce rebels to contest the ground; with the various armies he inflicted a great defeat, pressed Kunshan city, and with Li Hengsong attacked from both sides; the rebel chieftain, the false Dynasty General, escaped beforehand.

sentences.zh: 踰月，學啟攻東城，戈登自果浦河奄至，扼守西路，分道疾攻。

translations.literal: After a month Xueqi attacked the east wall; Gordon came suddenly along the Guopu River, held the west road, and they attacked swiftly on separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: After a month Xueqi attacked the east wall; Gordon came suddenly along the Guopu River, held the west road, and they attacked swiftly on separate routes.

sentences.zh: 賊奪西門走，阻水，殲焉。

translations.literal: The rebels seized the west gate and fled; blocked by water, they were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized the west gate and fled; blocked by water, they were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 遂留駐昆城，策應各路。

translations.literal: He then remained stationed at Kunshan city to support the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: He then remained stationed at Kunshan city to support the various routes.

sentences.zh: 移師攻花涇港，知賊必不誡，率眾擊北門，毀城外賊壘。

translations.literal: He moved his army to attack Huajing Harbor; knowing the rebels would be unprepared, he led his force to strike the north gate and destroyed the rebel forts outside the wall.
translations.idiomatic: He moved his army to attack Huajing Harbor; knowing the rebels would be unprepared, he led his force to strike the north gate and destroyed the rebel forts outside the wall.

sentences.zh: 次日，賊降，收吳江、震澤而還。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels surrendered; he recovered Wujiang and Zhenze and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels surrendered; he recovered Wujiang and Zhenze and returned.

sentences.zh: 以事謁鴻章於上海。

translations.literal: He went to call on Hongzhang at Shanghai on business.
translations.idiomatic: He went to call on Hongzhang at Shanghai on business.

sentences.zh: 先是白齊文閉松城索餉，既撤，潛通賊，領二百人入蘇州。

translations.literal: Earlier Burgevine had closed Songjiang city demanding pay; after he was dismissed he secretly communicated with the rebels and led two hundred men into Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Burgevine had closed Songjiang city demanding pay; after he was dismissed he secretly communicated with the rebels and led two hundred men into Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 戈登诇知之，亟返崑山為備。

translations.literal: Gordon learned of it through intelligence and hastened back to Kunshan to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Gordon learned of it through intelligence and hastened back to Kunshan to prepare.

sentences.zh: 旋攻蘇城，率軍三千，與學啟俱力爭要害，稍剪城外賊壘。

translations.literal: Soon he attacked Suzhou city, leading three thousand troops; with Xueqi he jointly contested the key points and gradually cut down the rebel forts outside the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he attacked Suzhou city, leading three thousand troops; with Xueqi he jointly contested the key points and gradually cut down the rebel forts outside the wall.

sentences.zh: 偽忠王李秀成聞警赴援，屢敗；

translations.literal: The false Loyal King Li Xiucheng heard the alarm and came to reinforce but was repeatedly defeated;
translations.idiomatic: The false Loyal King Li Xiucheng heard the alarm and came to reinforce but was repeatedly defeated;

sentences.zh: 而紹光所部每戰猶致死，自偽納王郜雲官以下，皆萌貳志，詣營乞降。

translations.literal: yet Shaoguang's troops still fought to the death in every battle; from the false Minister King Gou Yun'guan downward all conceived thoughts of defection and came to the camp to beg surrender.
translations.idiomatic: yet Shaoguang's troops still fought to the death in every battle; from the false Minister King Gou Yun'guan downward all conceived thoughts of defection and came to the camp to beg surrender.

sentences.zh: 乃與學啟乘單舸會雲官等於洋澄湖，令斬秀成、紹光以獻，學啟與誓，戈登證之。

translations.literal: He and Xueqi then took a single boat to meet Yun'guan and others at Yangcheng Lake, ordering them to behead Xiucheng and Shaoguang as proof; Xueqi swore an oath and Gordon witnessed it.
translations.idiomatic: He and Xueqi then took a single boat to meet Yun'guan and others at Yangcheng Lake, ordering them to behead Xiucheng and Shaoguang as proof; Xueqi swore an oath and Gordon witnessed it.

sentences.zh: 未幾，秀成遁，雲官殺紹光，開齊門迎降，賞頭等功牌、銀幣，並犒其軍。

translations.literal: Before long Xiucheng escaped; Yun'guan killed Shaoguang, opened Qi Gate to welcome surrender; first-class merit plaques and silver coins were granted, and their army was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xiucheng escaped; Yun'guan killed Shaoguang, opened Qi Gate to welcome surrender; first-class merit plaques and silver coins were granted, and their army was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 助攻宜興、溧陽，並擊退楊舍賊。

translations.literal: He assisted in attacking Yixing and Liyang and also drove back the rebels at Yangshe.
translations.idiomatic: He assisted in attacking Yixing and Liyang and also drove back the rebels at Yangshe.

sentences.zh: 進規常州，轟破南門，合諸軍掘壕築牆以敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing to plan for Changzhou, he shelled and broke the south gate; joining the various armies he dug trenches and built walls to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to plan for Changzhou, he shelled and broke the south gate; joining the various armies he dug trenches and built walls to defeat them.

sentences.zh: 敘功，賞黃馬褂、花翎，賜提督品級章服。

translations.literal: When merit was recorded, he was granted a yellow riding jacket and peacock feather and given grand coordinator rank regalia.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was recorded, he was granted a yellow riding jacket and peacock feather and given grand coordinator rank regalia.

sentences.zh: 初，戈登與學啟為昆弟交，每戰必偕。

translations.literal: Earlier Gordon and Xueqi had been as close as brothers and fought together in every battle.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Gordon and Xueqi had been as close as brothers and fought together in every battle.

sentences.zh: 及誅降酋，頗不直其所為，捧雲官首而哭，誓不與見。

translations.literal: When the surrendered chieftains were executed he strongly disapproved of the act, held Yun'guan's head and wept, and swore never to see Xueqi again.
translations.idiomatic: When the surrendered chieftains were executed he strongly disapproved of the act, held Yun'guan's head and wept, and swore never to see Xueqi again.

sentences.zh: 嗣聞學啟卒，悲不自勝，乞其戰時大旗二，攜歸國為遺念。

translations.literal: Later hearing that Xueqi had died, he was overcome with grief and begged for two of his battle flags, carrying them home as mementos.
translations.idiomatic: Later hearing that Xueqi had died, he was overcome with grief and begged for two of his battle flags, carrying them home as mementos.

sentences.zh: 戈登歸後，埃及亂，督師討之，遇害。

translations.literal: After Gordon returned, rebellion broke out in Egypt; he commanded troops to suppress it and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: After Gordon returned, rebellion broke out in Egypt; he commanded troops to suppress it and was killed.

sentences.zh: 朝廷遣使往吊焉。

translations.literal: The court sent an envoy to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent an envoy to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 戈登嘗言：「中國人民耐勞易使，果能教練，可轉弱為強。

translations.literal: Gordon once said: "The Chinese people endure hardship and are easy to command; if they can truly be trained, weakness can be turned to strength.
translations.idiomatic: Gordon once said: "The Chinese people endure hardship and are easy to command; if they can truly be trained, weakness can be turned to strength.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「中國海軍利於守，船砲之制，大不如小。

translations.literal: " He also said: "China's navy is suited to defense; in the design of ships and cannon, large is far inferior to small.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "China's navy is suited to defense; in the design of ships and cannon, large is far inferior to small.

sentences.zh: 」當時稱其將略云。

translations.literal: " At the time his generalship was praised.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time his generalship was praised.

sentences.zh: 日意格，法國人。

translations.literal: Degeorge was a Frenchman.
translations.idiomatic: Degeorge was a Frenchman.

sentences.zh: 嘗為其國參將，駐防上海。

translations.literal: He had once been an adjutant of his country, garrisoned at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: He had once been an adjutant of his country, garrisoned at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，改調稅務司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was transferred to customs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he was transferred to customs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 徙寧波，复郡城，與有功。

translations.literal: He moved to Ningbo, recovered the prefectural city, and had a share in the merit.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Ningbo, recovered the prefectural city, and had a share in the merit.

sentences.zh: 官軍攻慈谿，遣法兵馳往策應。

translations.literal: When the government army attacked Cixi, he sent French troops galloping to support them.
translations.idiomatic: When government forces attacked Cixi, he dispatched French troops to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 會餘姚四​​門鎮陷，遂與前護提督陳世章勒兵往討，踰月，直搗上虞。

translations.literal: Just then Simen Town in Yuyao fell; he then joined former Acting Provincial Commander Chen Shizhang in leading troops to suppress the rebels; after a month they struck straight at Shangyu.
translations.idiomatic: When Simen Town in Yuyao fell, he joined former Acting Provincial Commander Chen Shizhang in leading troops against the rebels; after a month they advanced straight on Shangyu.

sentences.zh: 賊緣道築卡樹柵，悉奪毀之，薄城，並力轟擊，賊殊死戰，賈勇直前，被創，眾軍繼進，斬級千，賊始渡曹娥江去。

translations.literal: The rebels built stockades and palisades along the road; all were seized and destroyed; pressing the city they shelled with combined force; the rebels fought to the death; with desperate courage he advanced and was wounded; the main army followed; a thousand heads were taken; the rebels at last crossed the Cao'e River and left.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels built stockades and palisades along the road, all of which were seized and destroyed; closing on the city they shelled with combined force; the rebels fought to the death; he charged forward with desperate courage and was wounded; the main army followed and took a thousand heads; the rebels at last crossed the Cao'e River and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 進攻奉化，與諸軍克之。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Fenghua, he joined the various armies and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Fenghua, he joined the other armies and captured it.

sentences.zh: 攻安吉思溪、雙福橋，駕小輪舶赴荻港，毀袁家匯賊壘，浙江平。

translations.literal: Attacking Anji's Jixi and Shuangfu Bridge, he drove a small steamer to Dih Harbor, destroyed the rebel fort at Yuanjia Hui, and Zhejiang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Anji's Jixi and Shuangfu Bridge, he drove a small steamer to Dih Harbor, destroyed the rebel fort at Yuanjia Hui, and Zhejiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠令與德克碑討測西邦製造，仿造小輪舶試行。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang ordered him and D'Aiguibelle to study and survey Western manufacturing and to trial-build small steamers.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang ordered him and D'Aiguibelle to survey Western manufacturing and trial-build small steamers.

sentences.zh: 五年，宗棠創福州船政局，充正監督，度地募工，殫心所事；

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Naval Yard; Degeorge served as chief superintendent, selected the site and recruited workers, and devoted himself wholeheartedly to the task;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1866) Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Naval Yard; Degeorge served as chief superintendent, selected the site and recruited workers, and devoted himself wholeheartedly to the task;

sentences.zh: 复籌設繪事院、小鐵廠。

translations.literal: He also planned and established a drawing academy and a small ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: He also planned and established a drawing academy and a small ironworks.

sentences.zh: 七年，加提督銜，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was given provincial commander rank and awarded the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1868) he was given provincial commander rank and awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以船政教導勞賞銀幣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was rewarded with silver coins for his labor in instructing the naval yard.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1874) he was rewarded with silver coins for his labor in instructing the naval yard.

sentences.zh: 光緒年，卒。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu reign he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died during the Guangxu reign.

sentences.zh: 德克碑，法參將。

translations.literal: D'Aiguibelle was a French adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: D'Aiguibelle was a French adjutant.

sentences.zh: 初，助攻奉化有功。

translations.literal: Earlier he had merit in the joint attack on Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier he had distinguished himself in the joint attack on Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 旋奉其公使檄，將受代歸，謁左宗棠，宗棠撫諭之。

translations.literal: Soon he received orders from his minister to be relieved and return home; he called on Zuo Zongtang, and Zongtang comforted and instructed him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he received orders from his minister to be relieved and return home; he called on Zuo Zongtang, who comforted and instructed him.

sentences.zh: 德克碑感服，願易服色受節度。

translations.literal: D'Aiguibelle was deeply moved and offered to change his dress and accept Chinese command.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply moved, D'Aiguibelle offered to change his dress and accept Chinese command.

sentences.zh: 令駐守蕭山。

translations.literal: He was ordered to garrison Xiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison Xiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧攻杭城，檄助戰，游擊何文秀攻雞籠山，德克碑從寶塔嶺登岸，攻倚城賊壘。

translations.literal: Jiang Yilin attacked Hangzhou city and ordered him to assist; Guerrilla Officer He Wenxiu attacked Jilong Hill; D'Aiguibelle landed from Baota Ridge and attacked the rebel forts leaning on the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yilin attacked Hangzhou and ordered him to assist; Guerrilla Officer He Wenxiu attacked Jilong Hill; D'Aiguibelle landed from Baota Ridge and attacked the rebel forts along the city wall.

sentences.zh: 會天大霧，賊扌冓嘉興援賊自萬松嶺偪都司張誌公營，勢張甚。

translations.literal: Just then a great fog arose; rebels from Jiaxing supporting the enemy pressed from Wansong Ridge upon Battalion Commander Zhang Zhigong's camp with very strong force.
translations.idiomatic: A great fog arose; Jiaxing relief rebels pressed from Wansong Ridge upon Battalion Commander Zhang Zhigong's camp with overwhelming force.

sentences.zh: 德克碑率眾助擊，敗之。

translations.literal: D'Aiguibelle led his force to assist in the attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: D'Aiguibelle led his men to assist and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 益澧督水陸軍並進，連破九壘，令總兵高連升據其五，德克碑據其二，屯饅頭山。

translations.literal: Yilin directed land and water forces forward together, breaking nine forts in succession; he ordered Brigadier Gao Liansheng to hold five of them and D'Aiguibelle two, encamped at Mantou Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Yilin directed land and water forces forward together, breaking nine forts in succession; Brigadier Gao Liansheng was assigned five and D'Aiguibelle two, encamped at Mantou Hill.

sentences.zh: 轟潰城數丈，毀鳳山門，官軍為承，城遂復。

translations.literal: Shelling breached several zhang of wall and destroyed Fengshan Gate; the government army served as the supporting force, and the city was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Shelling breached several zhang of wall and destroyed Fengshan Gate; government troops followed up as the supporting force, and the city was recovered.

sentences.zh: 賊潰，奔湖州。

translations.literal: The rebels were routed and fled toward Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were routed and fled toward Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 攻安吉思溪，德克碑率所部助之，轟擊雙福橋，不克，駕小舟泊河汊，火八角亭，支木橋以濟。

translations.literal: Attacking Anji's Jixi, D'Aiguibelle led his own troops to assist; shelling Shuangfu Bridge failed to take it; he drove a small boat to moor in a river fork, set fire to Bajiao Pavilion, and laid wooden bridges to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Anji's Jixi, D'Aiguibelle led his own troops to assist; shelling Shuangfu Bridge failed to take it; he drove a small boat to a river fork, set fire to Bajiao Pavilion, and laid wooden bridges to cross.

sentences.zh: 賊阻兵中流不得進，德克碑賈勇偪岸，所部遇伏卻走，改趨荻港，越壕入，克三壘。

translations.literal: Rebel troops blocked the stream and he could not advance; D'Aiguibelle with desperate courage pressed the shore; his unit met an ambush and fell back; he turned toward Dih Harbor, crossed the moat and entered, and took three forts.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel troops blocked the stream and he could not advance; D'Aiguibelle pressed the shore with desperate courage; his unit met an ambush and fell back; he turned toward Dih Harbor, crossed the moat, entered, and took three forts.

sentences.zh: 事寧，撤兵還上海。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled the troops were withdrawn to Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were settled the troops were withdrawn to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 五年，充船政局副監督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he served as deputy superintendent of the naval yard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1866) he served as deputy superintendent of the naval yard.

sentences.zh: 七年，馬尾設船廠，督役興工，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the shipyard was established at Mawei; he supervised the work and was awarded the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1868) the shipyard was established at Mawei; he supervised construction and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 九年，宗棠平回亂，檄調甘肅，隸麾下。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when Zongtang pacified the Muslim rebellions, he was ordered transferred to Gansu and placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1870), when Zongtang pacified the Muslim rebellions, he was ordered to Gansu and placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 十三年，錄經始船政勞，膺獎賞。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year his founding labor at the naval yard was recorded and he received reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1874) his founding labor at the naval yard was recorded and he received reward.

sentences.zh: 後卒。

translations.literal: Later he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died later.

sentences.zh: 赫德，字鷺賓，英國倍爾發司人。

translations.literal: Hart, style name Lubin, was a man of Belfast in Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Hart, style name Lubin, was from Belfast in Britain.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，來中國，充寧波領事署繙譯官，調廣州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he came to China, served as translator at the Ningbo consulate, and was transferred to Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng (1854) he came to China, served as translator at the Ningbo consulate, and was transferred to Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 又充香港督署書記官。

translations.literal: He also served as clerk at the Hong Kong governor's office.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as clerk at the Hong Kong governor's office.

sentences.zh: 九年，改任粵海關副稅務司。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was made deputy commissioner of the Guangdong Maritime Customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1859) he was made deputy commissioner of the Guangdong Maritime Customs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，總稅務司李泰國奉令購戰艦，以赫德權代之，赴長江新開各口岸置新關。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Inspector General Lay was ordered to purchase warships; Hart was appointed acting in his place and went to the newly opened Yangtze ports to establish new customs stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1861) Inspector General Lay was ordered to purchase warships; Hart was appointed acting in his place and went to the newly opened Yangtze ports to establish new customs stations.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，李泰國去職，赫德實授，徙駐上海。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi Lay left office; Hart received formal appointment and moved his headquarters to Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi (1863) Lay left office; Hart received formal appointment and moved his headquarters to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 三年，置台灣南北新關。

translations.literal: In the third year new customs were established in northern and southern Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1864) new customs were established in northern and southern Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 還駐京，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: Returning to station in the capital, he was given surveillance commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to station in the capital, he was given surveillance commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，晉布政使銜，赴緣海各地度置鐙樓塔表。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner rank and went to coastal regions to survey and place beacon towers and channel markers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1869) he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner rank and went to coastal regions to survey and place beacon towers and channel markers.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，佐定砲台條約。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he assisted in drafting the fort treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu (1876) he assisted in drafting the fort treaty.

sentences.zh: 十年，赴金陵與法使議越南案。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he went to Jinling to negotiate the Annam case with the French minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1884) he went to Jinling to negotiate the Annam case with the French minister.

sentences.zh: 會巡船置鐙樓台灣洋，為法虜，乃遣駐英稅務司金登幹赴巴黎申理，乘機與議停戰草約，還。

translations.literal: Just then a patrol boat placing beacons in Taiwan waters was captured by France; he sent Customs Commissioner in Britain Robert Hart to Paris to state the case, and took the opportunity to negotiate a draft armistice, then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Just then a patrol boat placing beacons in Taiwan waters was captured by France; he sent Commissioner Robert Hart in Britain to Paris to state the case, and took the opportunity to negotiate a draft armistice, then returned.

sentences.zh: 未幾，其國授為清、韓駐使，不就。

translations.literal: Before long his country offered him appointment as minister to Qing and Korea, but he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Before long his country offered him appointment as minister to Qing and Korea, but he declined.

sentences.zh: 逾年，賞花翎、雙龍二等第一寶星。

translations.literal: The next year he was granted the peacock feather and the first-class second-rank Double Dragon Precious Star.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was granted the peacock feather and the first-class second-rank Double Dragon Precious Star.

sentences.zh: 十二年，赴香港、澳門，條議洋藥稅釐並徵，並置關九龍、拱北。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he went to Hong Kong and Macao to negotiate joint levy of opium duties and to establish customs at Kowloon and Gongbei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1886) he went to Hong Kong and Macao to negotiate joint levy of opium duties and to establish customs at Kowloon and Gongbei.

sentences.zh: 十三年，葡使來華，與訂澳門草約。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Portuguese minister came to China and he concluded the draft Macao treaty with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1887) the Portuguese minister came to China and he concluded the draft Macao treaty with him.

sentences.zh: 十五年，藏兵寇哲孟雄，英兵乘勢闌入，赫德遣其弟稅務司赫政馳往，與駐藏大臣會籌劃界諸事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Tibetan troops raided Bhutan; British troops took advantage and forced their way in; Hart sent his younger brother Commissioner Hart to hurry there and, with the resident in Tibet, jointly planned boundary matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1889) Tibetan troops raided Bhutan; British troops took advantage and forced their way in; Hart sent his younger brother Commissioner Hart to hurry there and, with the resident in Tibet, jointly planned boundary matters.

sentences.zh: 十九年，賞三代一品封典。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was granted first-rank enfeoffment for three generations.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1893) he was granted first-rank enfeoffment for three generations.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，與德使籌置膠海新關。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he negotiated with the German minister to establish the new Jiaozhou customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year (1899) he negotiated with the German minister to establish the new Jiaozhou customs.

sentences.zh: 明年，各國聯軍入京，贊襄和議，晉太子少保。

translations.literal: The next year the allied armies of various countries entered the capital; he assisted in the peace negotiations and was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The next year (1900) the allied armies of various countries entered the capital; he assisted in the peace negotiations and was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，召入覲，賜「福」字。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was summoned to audience and granted the character "Fu" (Blessing).
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1902) he was summoned to audience and granted the character "Fu" (Blessing).

sentences.zh: 三十一年，與德使更議膠關章程，改行無稅區地法。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he again negotiated Jiaozhou customs regulations with the German minister, changing to the duty-free zone law.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1905) he again negotiated Jiaozhou customs regulations with the German minister, changing to the duty-free zone law.

sentences.zh: 尋與日使籌置大連灣新關，徵榷一如膠海。

translations.literal: Soon he negotiated with the Japanese minister to establish the new Dalian Bay customs, with taxation the same as Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he negotiated with the Japanese minister to establish the new Dalian Bay customs, with taxation the same as Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，東三省度地置關。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year customs were surveyed and established in the three eastern provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year (1907) customs were surveyed and established in the three eastern provinces.

sentences.zh: 逾年，謝病歸，詔許之，加尚書銜。

translations.literal: After a year he asked leave on grounds of illness and returned home; the edict permitted it and he was given minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he asked leave on grounds of illness and returned home; the edict permitted it and he was given minister rank.

sentences.zh: 赫德官中國垂五十年，頗與士大夫往還。

translations.literal: Hart held office in China for nearly fifty years and associated considerably with scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: Hart held office in China for nearly fifty years and associated considerably with scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 嘗教其子習製藝文，擬應試，未許。

translations.literal: He once taught his son the examination essay form, intending him to sit for the civil service examinations, but permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: He once taught his son the examination essay form, intending him to sit for the civil service examinations, but permission was not granted.

sentences.zh: 總署嘗擬請授總海防司，道員薛福成以其陰鷙專利，常內西人而外中國，上書鴻章力爭之，議始寢。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen once planned to appoint him Director General of Coastal Defense; Circuit Intendant Xue Fucheng, deeming him secretive and self-seeking, often siding with Westerners against China, memorialized Hongzhang in strong opposition, and the plan was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen once planned to appoint him Director General of Coastal Defense; Circuit Intendant Xue Fucheng, deeming him secretive and self-seeking and often siding with Westerners against China, memorialized Hongzhang in strong opposition, and the plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 辛亥後，病卒，賜優恤。

translations.literal: After the Xinhai revolution he died of illness; generous relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xinhai revolution he died of illness; generous relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 帛黎，法國人。

translations.literal: Protet was a Frenchman.
translations.idiomatic: Protet was a Frenchman.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，來中國，充福州船政學校教員。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tongzhi he came to China and served as instructor at the Fuzhou Naval School.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tongzhi (1869) he came to China and served as instructor at the Fuzhou Naval School.

sentences.zh: 十二年，賞五品銜，予雙龍獎牌。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was granted fifth rank and given a Double Dragon medal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1873) he was granted fifth rank and given a Double Dragon medal.

sentences.zh: 明年，調充江海關稅務幫辦，歷鎮江、北海、甌海、臨海、粵海諸關。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred as assistant at the Jiangsu Maritime Customs, serving in succession at Zhenjiang, Beihai, Ouhai, Linhai, and Yuehai customs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred as assistant at the Jiangsu Maritime Customs, serving in succession at Zhenjiang, Beihai, Ouhai, Linhai, and Yuehai customs.

sentences.zh: 光緒十九年，晉三品銜，調北京，遷稅務司。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu he was promoted to third rank, transferred to Beijing, and moved to customs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu (1893) he was promoted to third rank, transferred to Beijing, and appointed customs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，朝議行郵政，以赫德兼領其事，帛黎實參治之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the court debated establishing a postal service; Hart was placed in charge concurrently and Protet actually assisted in administering it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1896) the court debated establishing a postal service; Hart was placed in charge concurrently and Protet actually assisted in administering it.

sentences.zh: 凡都會、省城、通商口岸，漸次置局，命曰「大清郵政」。

translations.literal: In all capitals, provincial seats, and treaty ports, offices were gradually established, named the "Great Qing Post."
translations.idiomatic: In all capitals, provincial seats, and treaty ports, offices were gradually established under the name "Great Qing Post."

sentences.zh: 尋徙拱北。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Gongbei.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Gongbei.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，還京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1900) he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷郵政總辦，晉二品銜。

translations.literal: The next year he was moved to Director General of Posts and promoted to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next year (1901) he was appointed Director General of Posts and promoted to second rank.

sentences.zh: 置代辦局於蕪湖​​。

translations.literal: Agency offices were established at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Agency offices were established at Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，河南、山東、山西、貴州復置副總局，自是內地城鄉村鎮，街郵遍設。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year sub-head offices were again established in Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Guizhou; from then on postal routes were set up throughout inland cities, towns, and villages.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1903) sub-head offices were again established in Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Guizhou; from then on postal routes were set up throughout inland cities, towns, and villages.

sentences.zh: 時尚未入萬國郵政公會，即已與日本及英屬印度、香港聯約試行。

translations.literal: Although China had not yet entered the Universal Postal Union, it had already concluded trial agreements with Japan and with British India and Hong Kong.
translations.idiomatic: Although China had not yet entered the Universal Postal Union, it had already concluded trial agreements with Japan and with British India and Hong Kong.

sentences.zh: 三十年，賞雙龍三等第一寶星。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was granted the third-rank first-class Double Dragon Precious Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year (1904) he was granted the third-rank first-class Double Dragon Precious Star.

sentences.zh: 與法、德及英屬那達商定聯郵章程。

translations.literal: He concluded joint postal regulations with France, Germany, and British Nada.
translations.idiomatic: He concluded joint postal regulations with France, Germany, and British Nada.

sentences.zh: 先後成郵政六百餘局，代辦四千二百餘所。

translations.literal: In all, more than six hundred post offices and more than four thousand two hundred agencies were established.
translations.idiomatic: In all, more than six hundred post offices and more than four thousand two hundred agencies were established.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改隸郵傳部，設總局，尚書盛宣懷疏薦之，遂被命為總辦，郵局置官自此始。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong control passed to the Ministry of Posts and Telegraphs and a head office was established; Minister Sheng Xuanhuai memorialized recommending him, and he was appointed director general; from this the postal service first received official appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong (1911) control passed to the Ministry of Posts and Telegraphs and a head office was established; Minister Sheng Xuanhuai memorialized recommending him, and he was appointed director general—from this the postal service first received official appointments.

sentences.zh: 越二年，乞病歸。

translations.literal: After two years he begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: After two years he begged leave on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：華爾、戈登先後領常勝軍，立功江、浙，世稱「洋將」，時傳其戰略。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Ward and Gordon in succession led the Ever-Victorious Army, achieved merit in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and were called "foreign generals" by the world; their battle plans were circulated at the time.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Ward and Gordon in succession led the Ever-Victorious Army, achieved merit in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and were known as "foreign generals"; their battle plans were widely discussed at the time.

sentences.zh: 日意格初亦參防戰，繼以船政著勞。

translations.literal: Degeorge at first also took part in defense fighting, and later won distinction through the naval yard.
translations.idiomatic: Degeorge at first also took part in defense fighting, and later won distinction through the naval yard.

sentences.zh: 赫德久總稅務，兼司郵政，頗與聞交涉，號曰「客卿」，皆能不負所事。

translations.literal: Hart long headed the customs service and concurrently managed the post; he was much involved in diplomacy and was called a "guest minister"; all were able to fulfill their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Hart long headed the customs service and concurrently managed the post; he was much involved in diplomacy and was called a "guest minister"—all were able to fulfill their duties.

sentences.zh: 茲數人者，受官職，易冠服，或原隸國籍。

translations.literal: These several men received official posts, changed their dress, or had originally entered foreign nationality.
translations.idiomatic: These several men received official posts, changed their dress, or had originally held foreign nationality.

sentences.zh: 食其祿者忠其事，實有足多，故並著於篇。

translations.literal: Those who eat the ruler's salary are loyal to his affairs; they truly have much to commend them, and therefore are all recorded in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Those who eat the ruler's salary are loyal to his affairs; they truly have much to commend them, and therefore are all recorded in this chapter.
